about: Indian Oil Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the oil, gas, petrochemicals, and alternative energy source businesses in India and internationally. It operates through Sale of Petroleum Products, Sale of Petrochemicals, Sale of Gas, and Other segments. The company is involved in the refining of petroleum products; exploration and production of crude oil and gas; explosives and cryogenic businesses; pipeline transportation of crude oil, petroleum, and gas; petrochemica
